source_text: Inducens planta eos in monte hereditatis tuae. Non vult nos erraticos; plantatio firma in Christo. Mons — ecclesia vel contemplatio.
pass_a_gloss: Leading-in plant them on mountain of-inheritance your. Not he-wills us wanderers; planting firm in Christ. Mountain — church or contemplation.
pass_b_english: [[Leading them in, plant them on the mountain of your inheritance >> Bible:Exodus 15:17]]. God does not want wanderers; he wants a planting firm [[in Christ >> Bible:Colossians 2:7]]. The mountain is church — or the height of contemplation.
